thread:
ava: idea  bounded "sticky overrides" primitive for runtime config. short-lived, affinity-bound overrides with TTL + leak protection. want quick feedback before RFC.

sam: sounds useful. affinity = session|tenant|user? how handle prefix caches?

ava: yes. apply sticky after route selection but before prefix/KV cache lookup so TTL honors.

marta: product needs: console list of active stickies, creator, TTL, revoke, and cap usage. timeline view would help.

jin: ops risk: routing map growth. propose per-tenant cap (default 200), warning at 150, eviction oldest-first or LRU.

ava: add global hard max TTL (24h). owner can request ops approval to extend.

sam: telemetry events: sticky.override.created, .applied, .evicted, .leak_detected. labels: affinity, scope_id, creator, mode. sample_rate label too.

marta: console preview idea: run shadow sticky against recent 10m window and show estimated qps% + cost delta before activation.

jin: shadow mode doable via evaluation-only path + diff report. ops-bot can enqueue replay/dry-run.

config-bot: dry-run stky-6501-01  10m window, 0.52% affected, mean latency +1.9ms, cost +0.7%.

sam: API sketch:
POST /v1/runtime/overrides
{ "affinity":"tenant", "selector":"org-123", "delta":{"route.default.model":"ggml-3-small"}, "mode":"shadow|active", "ttl_seconds":3600, "max_coverage_percent":5, "eviction_policy":"oldest|lru", "telemetry_sample_rate":0.01, "reason":"string", "owner_contact":"name@redwood.com" }

ava: edge cases: if route removed mark sticky "orphaned" and auto-expire (5m). console should surface orphans.

lex: security: tenant stickies RBAC-gated; private deploys default off; option require_2fa_for_tenant_sticky.

jin: impl notes: sticky map sharded by tenant hash; fast-path lookup (tenant, session); TTL eviction via per-shard timer wheel; local counters + eventual aggregator. cap per-shard with eviction policy.

marta: i'll mock console list + preview + revoke. sam: telemetry contract? jin: infra review?

sam: i'll own telemetry schema and sample rules.

jin: i'll review infra and memory guards.

ava: thanks. i'll write RFC draft with API + console mocks + telemetry contract. filing if no objections in 48h. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: note  RFC draft created: https://git.internal/r/redwood/rfcs/6501 (stky-bounded-overrides).
